name: course-completion
description: Find why a Teachable learner's next lesson is locked or Complete and Continue will not advance. Use pasted settings and learner records to find why a lesson stays locked or Complete and Continue does not advance. Review quiz attempts separately to distinguish passing scores, blank results, remaining retakes and exhausted attempts. Return case evidence and a targeted next check or recovery recommendation. Not for creating courses, changing accounts or connecting to a school.
